reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset, and Brown read Paul's disclaimer of a direct command as ordinary apostolic inspiration, not an admission that the verse itself lacks inspiration.

sides.snippet: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.
sides.verseText: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

sides.snippet: Every writing inspired by God is profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction which is in righteousness,
